newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia MoF to get more control over budget funds.
newsitem.headline: Russia MoF to get more control over budget funds.

text.p: Russian Finance Ministry has prepared a draft decree which restores the authority of the ministry over budget funds spending, Finance Minister Alexander Livshits said on Thursday.

The move is part of a government plan to limit the role of private banks in servicing payments in and out of the federal budget under which standard budget payments would eventually be handled by a federal treasury, which is currently being set up.
Banks authorised to handle payments for the government would continue to do so for special programmes.
